duplicate-id.yaml.why: the network row reuses the runtime row's id

duplicate-key-row.yaml.why: `tenant` twice in one row; the later value would override the first

invalid-id-uppercase.yaml.why: an id with an upper-case letter

invalid-region-3az-row-only.yaml.why: a 3-AZ region id on a row only (values are checked before scope membership)

invalid-region-3az.yaml.why: a 3-AZ region id (EU-WEST-PAR), refused until 3-AZ regions are handled (coordinator 2026-10-07)

invalid-stage.yaml.why: a stage outside the stage enum

platform-missing-project.yaml.why: network and runtime consume a project that has no row

platform-missing-tenant-state.yaml.why: tenant rows for demo without its tenant-state row

platform-two-bootstraps.yaml.why: two bootstrap rows (one owner per scope)

platform-two-tenant-states.yaml.why: two tenant-state rows for one tenant

scope-unknown-environment.yaml.why: a row for an environment not under its tenant

scope-unknown-region.yaml.why: a row for a region not under its environment

scope-unknown-tenant.yaml.why: a row for a tenant not under spec.tenants

shared-state-false.yaml.why: state project = demo/dev project with shared_state_project false

shared-state-without-sandbox.yaml.why: state project = demo/dev project without spec.sandbox

stage-account-admin.yaml.why: an account-admin row (reserved: bootstrap:account creates the admin)

syntax-block-yaml.yaml.why: block-style YAML instead of the JSON-compatible flow form

syntax-second-document.yaml.why: a second YAML document after the first

syntax-trailing-comment.yaml.why: a comment after a value (only whole-line comments are allowed)

tenant-scope-bootstrap-row.yaml.why: a bootstrap row in a tenant-only manifest

tenant-scope-duplicate-external-id.yaml.why: a row reuses an external entry's id

tenant-scope-governance-row.yaml.why: account-governance as a row instead of external

tenant-scope-no-external-governance.yaml.why: the account-governance producer is neither a row nor external

tenant-scope-no-external-tenant-state.ya.why: the tenant-state producer is neither a row nor external

tenant-scope-no-project.yaml.why: network and runtime consume a project that is neither a row nor external

tenant-scope-shared-state.yaml.why: state project = demo/dev project in a tenant-only manifest

tenant-scope-tenant-state-row.yaml.why: tenant-state as a row instead of external

two-runtimes-same-slot.yaml.why: two runtimes in one scope with the same slot

two-runtimes-without-slot.yaml.why: two runtimes in one scope, neither with a slot

unknown-field-case-variant.yaml.why: `Stage` beside `stage` (a case-insensitive decoder would merge them)

unknown-field-in-sandbox.yaml.why: an unknown key inside the optional spec.sandbox block

unknown-field-nested.yaml.why: an authored state bucket under spec.state (buckets are derived)

unknown-field-row-after.yaml.why: an authored `after` on a row (edges are derived, never authored)

unknown-field-top.yaml.why: a top-level key the schema does not have
